verdict.rationale: GitLab is a platform with built-in AI features (Duo Agent Platform), so a training opt-out or no-training data policy is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never mentions model-training data use, an opt-out, or a no-training commitment. The ability to turn the Agent Platform on or off (gitlab-docs-49/63) is an adjacent control that does not address training, and self-hosting options say nothing about training data use.
